title: parley error
description: Errors are data. measured, limit and remedy are what make an error actionable in one step rather than several.

seq.description: The run's single counter; 0 is the bootstrap line (spec §1.3).

run.description: The execution this line belongs to. Required on every line so a detached line can still be attributed (spec §1.3).

code.description: Stable identifier: two or more dot-separated segments of lowercase letters, digits and underscores (spec §6). Never a prose message.

problem.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

measured.description: The value observed, when the failure is a threshold.

limit.description: The threshold that was not met.

remedy.description: The lever to pull. Omit rather than invent one.

version.description: Full validation is against the schema for this exact id and version (spec §4.5, §4.6).
